intro: A Lieutenant's Insignia is an emblem worn by ranking members of the Burning Blade cult hiding within Durotar. Recovered by Horde adventurers, it serves as crucial evidence of cult activity operating dangerously close to Orgrimmar.

p: Recovered from cultists entrenched inside Skull Rock along Durotar's eastern shore, the Lieutenant's Insignia identifies its bearer as an officer within the Burning Blade. While Warchief Thrall refuses to tolerate traitors within his new nation, an outright purge would merely scatter the cult before its masters could be exposed. Instead, Thrall turns the badge into a counterfeit credential, handing it back to a trusted champion to test the allegiances of suspected infiltrators lurking directly beneath Orgrimmar.
